Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against the human glucocorticoid receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'glucocorticoid receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens', standard_type 'IC50', and require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
